versions.content: If the WdgMDevErrorDetect [ECUC_WdgM_00301] switch is enabled, the function WdgM_GetVersionInfo shall check if a NULL pointer is passed for the VersionInfo parameter. In case of an error the remaining function WdgM_GetVersionInfo shall not be executed and the function WdgM_GetVersionInfo shall report development error code WDGM_E_INV_POINTER to the Det_ReportError service of the Default Error Tracer.
